chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya'qub said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: 'An Umrah in every month.'

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended frequency for performing Umrah according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on expiations, this narration highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) emphasis on frequent voluntary worship as a means of spiritual purification. While often interpreted as a recommendation for regular spiritual renewal, scholars note it may also refer to the specific practice of performing Umrah during the months of Hajj or as a continuous act of devotion to maintain closeness to God.
